headline: SMBC Plans to Go Private and Delist, Holds EGMS at the End of November
summary: PT Bank SMBC Indonesia plans to go private and delist from the Indonesia Stock Exchange (BEI). The bank will hold an extraordinary shareholders' meeting in late November.
why: SMBC Indonesia is the Indonesian unit of Japan's Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation. A delisting removes a listed bank from public trading and shifts ownership control to a private structure.
original_headline: SMBC Mau Go Private dan Delisting, Gelar RUPSLB Akhir November
